name: Ratio Tipo-Token (TTR)
description: Computes the ratio of unique words to total words using MATTR variant para detectar generado por IA text's vocabulary patrones.
useCase: Detecting AI text through abnormal diversidad léxica ratios a través de text segments
mechanism: Calcula the Moving-Average Type-Token Ratio (MATTR) using a sliding window approach to mitigate text length effects. For each window of N words, the ratio of unique types to total tokens is computed, then averaged. generado por IA text often exhibits more uniform TTR values a través de windows compared to escritura humana, que naturally varies in vocabulary richness entre different sections due to topic shifts and stylistic changes.
source: Covington, M. A. & McFall, J. D. (2010) - Cutting the Gordian Knot: The Moving-Average Type-Token Ratio (MATTR), Journal of Quantitative Linguistics
algorithm: Moving-Average Type-Token Ratio (MATTR) + Variance Analysis + Segment Comparison
parameters: Tamaño de ventana: 50-100 tokens, Metrics: mean MATTR, MATTR varianza, MATTR range, Normalization: length-independent
strengths:
• Length-independent measurement via MATTR
• Well-established psycholinguistic metric
• Fast computation with minimal resources
• Captures vocabulary usage patrones
limitations:
• Lower discriminative power as standalone característica
• Sensitive to text genre and topic
• Advanced LLMs increasingly match human TTR ranges
• Window size selection affects results

references.title: Covington, M. A. & McFall, J. D. (2010). Cutting the Gordian Knot: The Moving-Average Type-Token Ratio (MATTR). Journal of Quantitative Linguistics.
Tulchinskii, E. et al. (2024). Intrinsic Dimension Estimation for Robust Detection of AI-Generated Texts. NeurIPS.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
